import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.PrincipalBudget
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.HatApproximationProvider

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V24 §1: the repaired completed-sieve provider and the V16
# coefficient contract

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## Part A — the coefficient contract (LEAN BANK)

* `SourceDecomposition λ Us Ur Cm` — `λ` is a finite linear combination `Σ_i c_i g_i` of
  coefficients `g_i` in the V16 bilinear source class (`SourceFactorization`: `g_i = u ⋆ v`,
  `u, v` one-bounded, `u` on `Us ∪ Ur`, `v` on the rough universe `Ur`), with coefficient mass
  `Σ_i |c_i| ≤ Cm`;
* `CountDetermined cell Ur ℓ` — the rough coefficient depends only on the cell-count vector
  (the rounded endpoints are cell endpoints);
* `pattern_representation` — a count-determined rough coefficient is EXACTLY a finite
  combination of cell-pattern indicators;
* `coloured_source_decomposition` — `β ⋆ ℓ` (`β` one-bounded on the smooth side) has an
  explicit source decomposition with mass `≤ (R+1)^{#cells} · 3^R`, built from the exact
  colouring identity and `coloured_weight_source_contract` (small primes in the FIRST bin, two
  independent rough factors);
* `push` / `push_conv` / `push_pull` — transfer from the finite atom type back to integers
  (atom sets `⊆ ℕ`);
* **`new_completed_weight_matches_V16_contract`** — the ACTUAL completed weight
  `Λ_new^+ = μ_E ⋆ β_sm^+ ⋆ ℓ_rd` (on `ℕ`) satisfies the V16 coefficient contract
  `SourceDecomposition Λ_new^+ (E ∪ Psm) Prd ((R+1)^{#cells} 3^R)`, for any count-determined
  rough factor with at most `R` rough atoms.

## Part B — providers

* `SourceClassDistributionProvider` (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; the inherited V16 analytic
  source-class / prime-distribution theorem, NOT re-proved): the distribution error functional
  is linear and uniformly small on the source class;
* `distribution_error_small` (LEAN CONDITIONAL) — the error of any weight with a bounded source
  decomposition is eventually `≤ ε`;
* **`RepairedCompletedSieveProvider`** — the bundle of ONLY the analytic inputs not kernel-proved
  in V21–V23: `RosserScalarProvider`, `PrimeHarmonicTupleProvider`, `PrincipalEulerProvider`,
  `HatReferenceApproximationProvider`, and the inherited source-class provider.  No finite CRT
  or positivity fact is in it; the small-prime Rosser weight needs no provider (it is
  constructed in V22: `rosserSmallProvider`).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV24
namespace RepairedProvider

open Finset
open ResearchBankV22.RoundedRoughSieve ResearchBankV22.CompletedPositiveWeight
open ResearchBankV22.CellColouring ResearchBankV22.IndependentFactorization
open ResearchBankV22.RosserCostProvider ResearchBankV22.SmallPrimeUpperSieve

/-! ## Part A — the coefficient contract -/

section Defs

variable {γ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ]

/-- **The V16 coefficient contract**: a finite combination of bilinear source-class
coefficients with coefficient mass at most `Cm`. -/
def SourceDecomposition (lam : Finset γ → ℝ) (Us Ur : Finset γ) (Cm : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι) (c : ι → ℝ) (g : ι → Finset γ → ℝ),
    (∀ i, SourceFactorization (g i) Us Ur) ∧ (∀ A, lam A = ∑ i, c i * g i A) ∧
      ∑ i, |c i| ≤ Cm

/-- The rough coefficient depends only on the cell-count vector. -/
def CountDetermined {J : Type*} [DecidableEq J] (cell : γ → J) (Ur : Finset γ) (ℓ : Finset γ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A B, A ⊆ Ur → B ⊆ Ur →
    (∀ j, (A.filter fun p => cell p = j).card = (B.filter fun p => cell p = j).card) → ℓ A = ℓ B

/-- `⋆` is linear in its second argument. -/
theorem conv_sum_right {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (β : Finset γ → ℝ) (c : ι → ℝ)
    (f : ι → Finset γ → ℝ) (A : Finset γ) :
    conv β (fun B => ∑ k ∈ s, c k * f k B) A = ∑ k ∈ s, c k * conv β (f k) A := by
  unfold conv
  simp only [mul_sum]
  rw [sum_comm]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun k _ => sum_congr rfl fun B _ => by ring

end Defs

section Pattern

variable {α J : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
  (cell : α → J) (Ur : Finset α) (ℓ : Finset α → ℝ)

open Classical in
/-- The finite set of count vectors of rough atom sets carrying a nonzero coefficient. -/
noncomputable def patterns : Finset (J → ℕ) := ((Ur.powerset.filter fun A => ℓ A ≠ 0)).image (cnt cell)

open Classical in
/-- A representative atom set of a count vector. -/
noncomputable def rep (κ : J → ℕ) : Finset α :=
  if h : κ ∈ patterns cell Ur ℓ then (mem_image.1 h).choose else ∅

omit [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] in
theorem rep_spec {κ : J → ℕ} (h : κ ∈ patterns cell Ur ℓ) :
    rep cell Ur ℓ κ ∈ Ur.powerset.filter (fun A => ℓ A ≠ 0) ∧ cnt cell (rep cell Ur ℓ κ) = κ := by
  unfold rep
  rw [dif_pos h]
  exact (mem_image.1 h).choose_spec

omit [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype J] in
theorem cellPattern_iff (alloc : (J → ℕ) → Fin 3 → J → ℕ)
    (halloc : ∀ κ j, ∑ i, alloc κ i j = κ j) (κ : J → ℕ) (A : Finset α) :
    CellPattern cell Ur (alloc κ) A ↔ A ⊆ Ur ∧ cnt cell A = κ := by
  unfold CellPattern PatCond target
  simp only [halloc]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, funext fun j => (h2 j).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, fun j => by rw [h2]⟩

omit [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] in
theorem sum_cnt (A : Finset α) : ∑ j, cnt cell A j = A.card := by
  unfold cnt
  exact (card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (fun p _ => mem_univ (cell p))).symm

variable {cell Ur ℓ}

omit [Fintype α] in
open Classical in
/-- **Pattern representation**: a count-determined rough coefficient is exactly a finite
combination of cell-pattern indicators. -/
theorem pattern_representation (hsupp : SupportedIn ℓ Ur) (hcd : CountDetermined cell Ur ℓ)
    (alloc : (J → ℕ) → Fin 3 → J → ℕ) (halloc : ∀ κ j, ∑ i, alloc κ i j = κ j)
    (A : Finset α) :
    ℓ A = ∑ κ ∈ patterns cell Ur ℓ,
      ℓ (rep cell Ur ℓ κ) * (if CellPattern cell Ur (alloc κ) A then 1 else 0) := by
  unfold CountDetermined at hcd
  simp_rw [cellPattern_iff cell Ur alloc halloc]
  by_cases hA : A ⊆ Ur
  · simp only [hA, true_and]
    by_cases hmem : cnt cell A ∈ patterns cell Ur ℓ
    · rw [sum_eq_single (cnt cell A) (fun κ _ hκ => by rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hκ), mul_zero])
        (fun h => absurd hmem h), if_pos rfl, mul_one]
      obtain ⟨hr, hc⟩ := rep_spec cell Ur ℓ hmem
      refine hcd _ _ hA (mem_powerset.1 (mem_filter.1 hr).1) fun j => ?_
      have := congrFun hc j
      unfold cnt at this
      exact this.symm
    · have h0 : ℓ A = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hmem (mem_image.2 ⟨A, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_powerset.2 hA, hne⟩, rfl⟩)
      rw [h0]
      refine (sum_eq_zero fun κ hκ => ?_).symm
      rw [if_neg (fun h : cnt cell A = κ => hmem (h ▸ hκ)), mul_zero]
  · simp only [hA, false_and, if_false, mul_zero, sum_const_zero]
    by_contra hne
    exact hA (hsupp A hne)

omit [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] in
theorem patterns_card_le {R : ℕ} (hR : ∀ A, A ⊆ Ur → ℓ A ≠ 0 → A.card ≤ R) :
    (patterns cell Ur ℓ).card ≤ (R + 1) ^ Fintype.card J := by
  have hsub : patterns cell Ur ℓ ⊆ Fintype.piFinset fun _ : J => range (R + 1) := by
    intro κ hκ
    obtain ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hκ
    rw [mem_filter, mem_powerset] at hA
    rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
    intro j
    rw [mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    calc cnt cell A j ≤ A.card := card_filter_le _ _
      _ ≤ R := hR A hA.1 hA.2
  calc (patterns cell Ur ℓ).card ≤ (Fintype.piFinset fun _ : J => range (R + 1)).card :=
        card_le_card hsub
    _ = (R + 1) ^ Fintype.card J := by simp [Fintype.card_piFinset]

variable {Us : Finset α} {β : Finset α → ℝ}

open Classical in
/-- **Coloured source decomposition** of `β ⋆ ℓ` (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem coloured_source_decomposition (hβ : SupportedIn β Us) (hβ1 : OneBounded β)
    (hd : Disjoint Us Ur) (hsupp : SupportedIn ℓ Ur) (hℓ1 : OneBounded ℓ)
    (hcd : CountDetermined cell Ur ℓ) (alloc : (J → ℕ) → Fin 3 → J → ℕ)
    (halloc : ∀ κ j, ∑ i, alloc κ i j = κ j) {R : ℕ}
    (hR : ∀ A, A ⊆ Ur → ℓ A ≠ 0 → A.card ≤ R) :
    SourceDecomposition (conv β ℓ) Us Ur (((R + 1) ^ Fintype.card J : ℕ) * 3 ^ R) := by
  set K := patterns cell Ur ℓ
  refine ⟨K × (α → Fin 3), inferInstance,
    fun iω => ℓ (rep cell Ur ℓ iω.1) * (piConst (alloc iω.1))⁻¹ / 3 ^ Fintype.card α,
    fun iω => colouredWeight cell Ur (alloc iω.1) β iω.2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro iω
    exact coloured_weight_source_contract cell (alloc iω.1) hβ hβ1 hd iω.2
  · intro A
    have hrep : ℓ = fun B => ∑ κ ∈ K, ℓ (rep cell Ur ℓ κ) *
        (if CellPattern cell Ur (alloc κ) B then 1 else 0) :=
      funext fun B => pattern_representation hsupp hcd alloc halloc B
    conv_lhs => rw [hrep]
    rw [conv_sum_right, Fintype.sum_prod_type, ← sum_coe_sort K]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun κ _ => ?_
    rw [colouring_factorization_identity cell (alloc κ) hβ hd A]
    unfold colourExp
    simp only [sum_div, mul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => ?_
    ring
  · rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    have h3 : (0 : ℝ) < 3 ^ Fintype.card α := by positivity
    have hinner : ∀ κ : K, ∑ ω : α → Fin 3,
        |ℓ (rep cell Ur ℓ κ) * (piConst (alloc κ))⁻¹ / 3 ^ Fintype.card α| =
        |ℓ (rep cell Ur ℓ κ)| * (piConst (alloc κ))⁻¹ := by
      intro κ
      have hp := piConst_pos (J := J) (alloc κ)
      rw [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, abs_div,
        abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hp), abs_of_pos h3]
      push_cast
      field_simp
    simp_rw [hinner]
    have hle : ∀ κ : K, |ℓ (rep cell Ur ℓ κ)| * (piConst (alloc κ))⁻¹ ≤ 3 ^ R := by
      intro κ
      obtain ⟨hr, hc⟩ := rep_spec cell Ur ℓ κ.2
      rw [mem_filter, mem_powerset] at hr
      have hsum : ∑ j, ∑ i, alloc κ i j ≤ R := by
        simp only [halloc]
        rw [← hc, sum_cnt]
        exact hR _ hr.1 hr.2
      have hpi := piProb_inv_le (J := J) (alloc κ) hsum
      have hp := piConst_pos (J := J) (alloc κ)
      calc |ℓ (rep cell Ur ℓ κ)| * (piConst (alloc κ))⁻¹ ≤ 1 * (piConst (alloc κ))⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hℓ1 _) (inv_pos.2 hp).le
        _ ≤ 3 ^ R := by rw [one_mul]; exact hpi
    calc ∑ κ : K, |ℓ (rep cell Ur ℓ κ)| * (piConst (alloc κ))⁻¹ ≤ ∑ _κ : K, (3 : ℝ) ^ R :=
          sum_le_sum fun κ _ => hle κ
      _ = (K.card : ℝ) * 3 ^ R := by rw [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_coe, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ _ := by
          gcongr
          exact_mod_cast patterns_card_le hR

end Pattern

/-! ### Transfer from a finite atom type back to atom sets of integers -/

section Transfer

variable {γ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ] (V : Finset γ)

/-- Atom sets of `V` as atom sets of `γ`. -/
def emb (A : Finset V) : Finset γ := A.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (· ∈ V))

/-- Push a weight on the finite atom type `V` forward to `γ` (zero off `V`). -/
noncomputable def push (g : Finset V → ℝ) : Finset γ → ℝ := fun A =>
  if A ⊆ V then g (A.subtype (· ∈ V)) else 0

theorem emb_subtype {A : Finset γ} (hA : A ⊆ V) : emb V (A.subtype (· ∈ V)) = A := by
  ext x; simp only [emb, mem_map, mem_subtype, Function.Embedding.coe_subtype]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact hy
  · intro hx; exact ⟨⟨x, hA hx⟩, hx, rfl⟩

theorem subtype_emb (A : Finset V) : (emb V A).subtype (· ∈ V) = A := by
  ext x; simp [emb]

omit [DecidableEq γ] in
theorem emb_subset (A : Finset V) : emb V A ⊆ V := by
  intro x hx; obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 hx; exact y.2

variable {V}

theorem push_pull {f : Finset γ → ℝ} (hf : SupportedIn f V) : push V (pull V f) = f := by
  funext A
  unfold push pull
  split_ifs with hA
  · change f (emb V _) = f A; rw [emb_subtype V hA]
  · by_contra h; exact hA (hf A (Ne.symm h))

theorem push_oneBounded {g : Finset V → ℝ} (hg : OneBounded g) : OneBounded (push V g) := by
  intro A; unfold push; split_ifs
  · exact hg _
  · simp

theorem push_supported {g : Finset V → ℝ} {U : Finset V} (hg : SupportedIn g U) :
    SupportedIn (push V g) (emb V U) := by
  intro A hA
  unfold push at hA
  split_ifs at hA with hAV
  · rw [← emb_subtype V hAV]
    exact map_subset_map.2 (hg _ hA)
  · exact absurd rfl hA

theorem push_conv (f g : Finset V → ℝ) : push V (conv f g) = conv (push V f) (push V g) := by
  funext A
  unfold push conv
  by_cases hA : A ⊆ V
  · rw [if_pos hA]
    refine sum_nbij' (fun B => emb V B) (fun B => B.subtype (· ∈ V)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro B hB
      rw [mem_powerset] at hB ⊢
      rw [← emb_subtype V hA]; exact map_subset_map.2 hB
    · intro B hB
      rw [mem_powerset] at hB ⊢
      intro x hx; rw [mem_subtype] at hx ⊢; exact hB hx
    · intro B _; exact subtype_emb V B
    · intro B hB
      rw [mem_powerset] at hB
      exact emb_subtype V (hB.trans hA)
    · intro B hB
      dsimp only
      rw [mem_powerset] at hB
      have h1 : emb V B ⊆ V := emb_subset V B
      have h2 : A \ emb V B ⊆ V := sdiff_subset.trans hA
      rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2, subtype_emb]
      congr 2
      ext x
      simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_subtype, emb, mem_map, Function.Embedding.coe_subtype]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hx, hnx⟩; exact ⟨hx, fun ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ => hnx (Subtype.ext hyx ▸ hy)⟩
      · rintro ⟨hx, hnx⟩; exact ⟨hx, fun hy => hnx ⟨x, hy, rfl⟩⟩
  · rw [if_neg hA]
    refine (sum_eq_zero fun B hB => ?_).symm
    dsimp only
    rw [mem_powerset] at hB
    by_cases h1 : B ⊆ V
    · have h2 : ¬ A \ B ⊆ V := by
        intro h2; apply hA; intro x hx
        by_cases hxB : x ∈ B
        · exact h1 hxB
        · exact h2 (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hx, hxB⟩)
      rw [if_neg h2, mul_zero]
    · rw [if_neg h1, zero_mul]

theorem push_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℝ) (g : ι → Finset V → ℝ) (A : Finset γ) :
    push V (fun B => ∑ i, c i * g i B) A = ∑ i, c i * push V (g i) A := by
  unfold push; split_ifs <;> simp

theorem push_source {g : Finset V → ℝ} {Us Ur : Finset V} (hg : SourceFactorization g Us Ur) :
    SourceFactorization (push V g) (emb V Us) (emb V Ur) := by
  obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hus, hvs, rfl⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨push V u, push V v, push_oneBounded hu, push_oneBounded hv, ?_, push_supported hvs,
    push_conv u v⟩
  have := push_supported hus
  simpa [emb, map_union] using this

/-- **Transfer of the coefficient contract** along `push`. -/
theorem push_sourceDecomposition {lam : Finset V → ℝ} {Us Ur : Finset V} {Cm : ℝ}
    (h : SourceDecomposition lam Us Ur Cm) :
    SourceDecomposition (push V lam) (emb V Us) (emb V Ur) Cm := by
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, c, g, hg, hlam, hmass⟩ := h
  refine ⟨ι, hι, c, fun i => push V (g i), fun i => push_source (hg i), fun A => ?_, hmass⟩
  have : lam = fun B => ∑ i, c i * g i B := funext hlam
  rw [this, push_sum]

theorem pull_supported {f : Finset γ → ℝ} {U : Finset γ} (hf : SupportedIn f U) :
    SupportedIn (pull V f) (U.subtype (· ∈ V)) := by
  intro A hA x hx
  rw [mem_subtype]
  exact hf _ hA (mem_map_of_mem _ hx)

omit [DecidableEq γ] in
theorem pull_oneBounded {f : Finset γ → ℝ} (hf : OneBounded f) : OneBounded (pull V f) :=
  fun _ => hf _

end Transfer


/-! ### Rounded rough weights are determined by their cell counts -/

section Rounded

variable {γ J : Type*} [LinearOrder γ] [LinearOrder J] [Fintype J] (cell : γ → J)
  (wc : J → ℝ) (X : ℝ)

/-- Generalized admissibility with an accumulated prefix product `P` and parity shift `par`. -/
def AdmGen (P : ℝ) (par : ℕ) (A : Finset γ) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ A, Even ((above A p).card + par) →
    P * (∏ q ∈ above A p, wc (cell q)) * wc (cell p) ^ 3 ≤ X

omit [LinearOrder J] [Fintype J] in
theorem adm_iff_admGen (A : Finset γ) :
    Adm (roundedCond (fun p => wc (cell p)) X) A ↔ AdmGen cell wc X 1 0 A := by
  unfold Adm AdmGen roundedCond; simp

omit [Fintype J] in
theorem above_insert_max {A : Finset γ} (hA : A.Nonempty) {p : γ} (hp : p ∈ A)
    (hne : p ≠ A.max' hA) : above A p = insert (A.max' hA) (above (A.erase (A.max' hA)) p) := by
  ext q
  simp only [above, mem_filter, mem_insert, mem_erase]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hq, hlt⟩
    by_cases hqa : q = A.max' hA
    · exact Or.inl hqa
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hqa, hq⟩, hlt⟩
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨⟨-, hq⟩, hlt⟩)
    · exact ⟨A.max'_mem hA, lt_of_le_of_ne (A.le_max' p hp) hne⟩
    · exact ⟨hq, hlt⟩

omit [LinearOrder J] [Fintype J] in
theorem admGen_erase_max {A : Finset γ} (hA : A.Nonempty) (P : ℝ) (par : ℕ) :
    AdmGen cell wc X P par A ↔
      (Even par → P * wc (cell (A.max' hA)) ^ 3 ≤ X) ∧
        AdmGen cell wc X (P * wc (cell (A.max' hA))) (par + 1) (A.erase (A.max' hA)) := by
  set a := A.max' hA
  have habove_a : above A a = ∅ := by
    ext q; simp only [above, mem_filter, notMem_empty, iff_false, not_and, not_lt]
    exact fun hq => A.le_max' q hq
  have hnot : ∀ p, a ∉ above (A.erase a) p := by
    intro p h; simp [above] at h
  have hkey : ∀ p ∈ A, p ≠ a →
      ((above A p).card + par = (above (A.erase a) p).card + (par + 1)) ∧
      P * (∏ q ∈ above A p, wc (cell q)) =
        P * wc (cell a) * ∏ q ∈ above (A.erase a) p, wc (cell q) := by
    intro p hp hne
    rw [above_insert_max hA hp hne, card_insert_of_notMem (hnot p), prod_insert (hnot p)]
    constructor <;> ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun hpar => ?_, fun p hp hpar => ?_⟩
    · have := h a (A.max'_mem hA) (by rw [habove_a, card_empty, zero_add]; exact hpar)
      rwa [habove_a, prod_empty, mul_one] at this
    · obtain ⟨hne, hpA⟩ := mem_erase.1 hp
      obtain ⟨hc, hprod⟩ := hkey p hpA hne
      have := h p hpA (by rw [hc]; exact hpar)
      rwa [hprod] at this
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ p hp hpar
    by_cases hpa : p = a
    · subst hpa
      rw [habove_a, prod_empty, mul_one]
      rw [habove_a, card_empty, zero_add] at hpar
      exact h1 hpar
    · obtain ⟨hc, hprod⟩ := hkey p hp hpa
      rw [hprod]
      exact h2 p (mem_erase.2 ⟨hpa, hp⟩) (by rw [← hc]; exact hpar)

variable {cell}

omit [Fintype J] in
theorem cell_max'_le (hmono : Monotone cell) {A B : Finset γ} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (hcnt : ∀ j, (A.filter fun p => cell p = j).card = (B.filter fun p => cell p = j).card) :
    cell (A.max' hA) ≤ cell (B.max' hB) := by
  have hpos : 0 < (B.filter fun p => cell p = cell (A.max' hA)).card := by
    rw [← hcnt]; exact card_pos.2 ⟨A.max' hA, mem_filter.2 ⟨A.max'_mem hA, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := card_pos.1 hpos
  rw [mem_filter] at hy
  rw [← hy.2]
  exact hmono (B.le_max' y hy.1)

omit [Fintype J] in
theorem cnt_erase_eq {A B : Finset γ} {a b : γ} (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B) (hab : cell a = cell b)
    (hcnt : ∀ j, (A.filter fun p => cell p = j).card = (B.filter fun p => cell p = j).card)
    (j : J) : ((A.erase a).filter fun p => cell p = j).card =
      ((B.erase b).filter fun p => cell p = j).card := by
  rw [filter_erase, filter_erase]
  by_cases hj : cell a = j
  · rw [card_erase_of_mem (mem_filter.2 ⟨ha, hj⟩), card_erase_of_mem (mem_filter.2 ⟨hb, hab ▸ hj⟩),
      hcnt]
  · have e1 : a ∉ A.filter (fun p => cell p = j) := fun h => hj (mem_filter.1 h).2
    have e2 : b ∉ B.filter (fun p => cell p = j) := fun h => hj (hab ▸ (mem_filter.1 h).2)
    rw [erase_eq_of_notMem e1, erase_eq_of_notMem e2, hcnt]

omit [LinearOrder γ] in
theorem card_eq_sum_cnt (A : Finset γ) :
    A.card = ∑ j, (A.filter fun p => cell p = j).card :=
  card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (fun p _ => mem_univ (cell p))

theorem admGen_count (hmono : Monotone cell) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ A B : Finset γ, A.card = n →
      (∀ j, (A.filter fun p => cell p = j).card = (B.filter fun p => cell p = j).card) →
      ∀ P par, (AdmGen cell wc X P par A ↔ AdmGen cell wc X P par B) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro A B hA hcnt P par
    have hA0 : A = ∅ := card_eq_zero.1 hA
    have hB0 : B = ∅ := by
      apply card_eq_zero.1
      rw [card_eq_sum_cnt (cell := cell) B, ← sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hcnt j,
        ← card_eq_sum_cnt, hA]
    rw [hA0, hB0]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro A B hA hcnt P par
    have hBc : B.card = n + 1 := by
      rw [card_eq_sum_cnt (cell := cell) B, ← sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hcnt j,
        ← card_eq_sum_cnt, hA]
    have hAn : A.Nonempty := card_pos.1 (by omega)
    have hBn : B.Nonempty := card_pos.1 (by omega)
    have hcell : cell (A.max' hAn) = cell (B.max' hBn) :=
      le_antisymm (cell_max'_le hmono hAn hBn hcnt)
        (cell_max'_le hmono hBn hAn fun j => (hcnt j).symm)
    rw [admGen_erase_max cell wc X hAn, admGen_erase_max cell wc X hBn, hcell]
    have hc' := cnt_erase_eq (A.max'_mem hAn) (B.max'_mem hBn) hcell hcnt
    have hcardA : (A.erase (A.max' hAn)).card = n := by
      rw [card_erase_of_mem (A.max'_mem hAn), hA]; rfl
    rw [ih _ _ hcardA hc']

/-- **Rounded rough weights are count-determined** (LEAN BANK): if the rounded endpoints are
cell endpoints (`w = wc ∘ cell`) and cells are monotone intervals, `ℓ_rd` depends only on the
cell-count vector. -/
theorem ellRd_countDetermined (hmono : Monotone cell) (U : Finset γ) :
    CountDetermined cell U (ellRd U (fun p => wc (cell p)) X) := by
  intro A B hA hB hcnt
  unfold ellRd ellW
  rw [if_pos hA, if_pos hB]
  have hcard : A.card = B.card := by
    rw [card_eq_sum_cnt (cell := cell) A, card_eq_sum_cnt (cell := cell) B]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hcnt j
  have hadm : Adm (roundedCond (fun p => wc (cell p)) X) A ↔
      Adm (roundedCond (fun p => wc (cell p)) X) B := by
    rw [adm_iff_admGen, adm_iff_admGen]
    exact admGen_count wc X hmono _ A B rfl hcnt 1 0
  rw [hcard]
  split_ifs with ha hb hb
  · rfl
  · exact absurd (hadm.1 ha) hb
  · exact absurd (hadm.2 hb) ha
  · rfl

end Rounded

section Contract

variable {J : Type} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]

open Classical in
/-- **The new completed weight satisfies the V16 coefficient contract** (LEAN BANK).
For the actual `Λ_new^+ = μ_E ⋆ β_sm^+ ⋆ ℓ_rd` on `ℕ` (pairwise disjoint `E`, `Psm`, `Prd`),
whose rounded rough factor is determined by its cell counts and has at most `R` atoms,
`Λ_new^+` is an explicit finite combination of V16 bilinear source-class coefficients
(small primes and `E` in the FIRST factor, two independent rough colour factors), with
coefficient mass `≤ (R+1)^{#cells} · 3^R`. -/
theorem new_completed_weight_matches_V16_contract {E Psm Prd : Finset ℕ} {level X : ℝ}
    {w : ℕ → ℝ} (h1 : Disjoint E Psm) (h2 : Disjoint E Prd) (h3 : Disjoint Psm Prd)
    (cell : ℕ → J) (hcd : CountDetermined cell Prd (ellRd Prd w X))
    (alloc : (J → ℕ) → Fin 3 → J → ℕ) (halloc : ∀ κ j, ∑ i, alloc κ i j = κ j) {R : ℕ}
    (hR : ∀ A, A ⊆ Prd → ellRd Prd w X A ≠ 0 → A.card ≤ R) :
    SourceDecomposition (LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X) (E ∪ Psm) Prd
      (((R + 1) ^ Fintype.card J : ℕ) * 3 ^ R) := by
  set V := E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd
  set β := conv (muE E) (rosserBeta Psm level)
  set ℓ := ellRd Prd w X
  have hβs : SupportedIn β (E ∪ Psm) := conv_supported (muE_supported E) (ellRd_supported _ _ _)
  have hβ1 : OneBounded β := conv_oneBounded_of_disjoint (muE_supported E)
    (ellRd_supported _ _ _) h1 (fun A => by unfold muE; split_ifs <;> simp)
    (ellRd_oneBounded _ _ _)
  have hℓs : SupportedIn ℓ Prd := ellRd_supported _ _ _
  have hd : Disjoint (E ∪ Psm) Prd := disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨h2, h3⟩
  have hEPV : E ∪ Psm ⊆ V := subset_union_left
  have hPV : Prd ⊆ V := subset_union_right
  -- pull back to the finite atom type `V`
  set Us' : Finset V := (E ∪ Psm).subtype (· ∈ V)
  set Ur' : Finset V := Prd.subtype (· ∈ V)
  have hd' : Disjoint Us' Ur' := by
    rw [disjoint_left]; intro x hx hx'
    rw [mem_subtype] at hx hx'
    exact disjoint_left.1 hd hx hx'
  have hcd' : CountDetermined (fun p : V => cell p) Ur' (pull V ℓ) := by
    unfold CountDetermined at hcd ⊢
    intro A B hA hB hcnt
    unfold pull
    refine hcd _ _ ?_ ?_ fun j => ?_
    · intro x hx; obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 hx; have := hA hy; rw [mem_subtype] at this
      exact this
    · intro x hx; obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 hx; have := hB hy; rw [mem_subtype] at this
      exact this
    · have := hcnt j
      rw [filter_map, filter_map, card_map, card_map]
      convert this using 3
  have hR' : ∀ A, A ⊆ Ur' → pull V ℓ A ≠ 0 → A.card ≤ R := by
    intro A hA hne
    have hsub : emb V A ⊆ Prd := by
      intro x hx; obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 hx; have := hA hy; rw [mem_subtype] at this
      exact this
    have := hR _ hsub hne
    rwa [emb, card_map] at this
  have hdec := coloured_source_decomposition (cell := fun p : V => cell p) (Ur := Ur')
    (ℓ := pull V ℓ) (Us := Us') (β := pull V β) (pull_supported hβs) (pull_oneBounded hβ1) hd'
    (pull_supported hℓs) (pull_oneBounded (ellRd_oneBounded _ _ _)) hcd' alloc halloc hR'
  have hpush := push_sourceDecomposition hdec
  rw [push_conv, push_pull (fun A hA => (hβs A hA).trans hEPV),
    push_pull (fun A hA => (hℓs A hA).trans hPV), emb_subtype V hEPV,
    emb_subtype V hPV] at hpush
  have hΛ : LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X = conv β ℓ := rfl
  rw [hΛ]
  exact hpush

/-- **The ACTUAL rounded completed weight satisfies the V16 coefficient contract** (LEAN BANK):
with cell-endpoint rounding `w = wc ∘ cell` on monotone cells, no count-determinacy hypothesis
is needed. -/
theorem rounded_completed_weight_matches_V16_contract {J : Type} [LinearOrder J] [Fintype J]
    {E Psm Prd : Finset ℕ} {level X : ℝ} (h1 : Disjoint E Psm) (h2 : Disjoint E Prd)
    (h3 : Disjoint Psm Prd) (cell : ℕ → J) (hmono : Monotone cell) (wc : J → ℝ)
    (alloc : (J → ℕ) → Fin 3 → J → ℕ) (halloc : ∀ κ j, ∑ i, alloc κ i j = κ j) {R : ℕ}
    (hR : ∀ A, A ⊆ Prd → ellRd Prd (fun p => wc (cell p)) X A ≠ 0 → A.card ≤ R) :
    SourceDecomposition (LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level (fun p => wc (cell p)) X) (E ∪ Psm) Prd
      (((R + 1) ^ Fintype.card J : ℕ) * 3 ^ R) :=
  new_completed_weight_matches_V16_contract h1 h2 h3 cell (ellRd_countDetermined wc X hmono Prd)
    alloc halloc hR

end Contract

/-! ## Part B — providers -/

/-- **The inherited V16 analytic source-class / prime-distribution provider** (EXTERNAL
PROVIDER; never constructed, NOT re-proved).  `DE M λ` is the distribution error of the
coefficient `λ` at scale `M`; it is linear in `λ` and uniformly small on the bilinear source
class with universes `Us S M`, `Ur S M`. -/
structure SourceClassDistributionProvider (Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ)
    (DE : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) : Prop where
  linear : ∀ M {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℝ) (g : ι → Finset ℕ → ℝ),
    DE M (fun A => ∑ i, c i * g i A) = ∑ i, c i * DE M (g i)
  class_bound : ∀ S : ℕ, ∀ ε > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, ∀ g : Finset ℕ → ℝ,
    SourceFactorization g (Us S M) (Ur S M) → |DE M g| ≤ ε

/-- **Distribution error of a weight with a bounded source decomposition** (LEAN CONDITIONAL
on the inherited source-class provider). -/
theorem distribution_error_small {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {DE : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (P : SourceClassDistributionProvider Us Ur DE) (S : ℕ) (lam : ℕ → Finset ℕ → ℝ) {Cm : ℝ}
    (hCm : 0 ≤ Cm) (hdec : ∀ M, SourceDecomposition (lam M) (Us S M) (Ur S M) Cm) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, |DE M (lam M)| ≤ ε := by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := P.class_bound S (ε / (Cm + 1)) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨M₀, fun M hM => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, c, g, hg, hlam, hmass⟩ := hdec M
  have : lam M = fun A => ∑ i, c i * g i A := funext hlam
  rw [this, P.linear]
  calc |∑ i, c i * DE M (g i)| ≤ ∑ i, |c i * DE M (g i)| := abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i, |c i| * (ε / (Cm + 1)) := by
        refine sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
        rw [abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM₀ M hM (g i) (hg i)) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = (∑ i, |c i|) * (ε / (Cm + 1)) := by rw [sum_mul]
    _ ≤ Cm * (ε / (Cm + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmass (by positivity)
    _ ≤ ε := by
        rw [mul_div_assoc', div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        nlinarith

open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler ResearchBankV23.HatApproximationProvider in
/-- **The repaired completed-sieve provider**: ONLY the analytic inputs not kernel-proved in
V21–V23 (EXTERNAL PROVIDER interfaces).  Finite CRT algebra, positivity, the colouring identity,
the coefficient contract and the rational budget are NOT fields: they are kernel theorems.  The
small-prime Rosser weight is constructed (`rosserSmallProvider`), so no small-prime provider is
needed. -/
structure RepairedCompletedSieveProvider (K : ℕ) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ)
    (Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ) (lev X : ℝ → ℝ) (wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℕ)
    (Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData) (LF I : ℝ) (S0 N Li : ℕ → ℝ) (phiW : ℝ)
    (model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h) (Kh : ℕ) (EAB : ℕ → ℝ) (Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ)
    (DE : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) where
  rosser : RosserScalarProvider K h F Psm Prd lev X
  tuple : PrimeHarmonicTupleProvider h Prd X wτ
  euler : PrincipalEulerProvider h r Sd LF I S0 N Li phiW model
  hat : HatReferenceApproximationProvider Kh EAB
  source : SourceClassDistributionProvider Us Ur DE

/-- The small-prime upper weight needs no provider: it is constructed (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem small_prime_weight_constructed (Psm : Finset ℕ) (level : ℝ) (hlev : 1 ≤ level)
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ Psm, 1 ≤ p) :
    (rosserSmallProvider Psm level hlev hP).beta = rosserBeta Psm level := rfl

end RepairedProvider
end ResearchBankV24
end Erdos287

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V24 §2: the repaired Route-C baseline

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## Data

* `LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M` — the ACTUAL completed weight `Λ_new^+` at family index
  `(S, τ)` and scale `M`: `μ_E ⋆ β_sm^+ ⋆ ℓ_rd` with small universe `Psm S M`, rough universe
  `Prd S M`, level `lev M = M^rho`, rounded endpoints `wτ τ M`, support `X M = M^{vartheta0}`;
* `RoundedCellData` — the rounding cells: monotone cell map, cell endpoints `wc`
  (`wτ τ M = wc ∘ cell` on the rough universe), three-bin allocation, atom bound `R`;
* `SieveGeometry` — disjointness of `E`, `Psm`, `Prd`, `h < 1` on the sieve primes, and the
  identification of the principal model universe and of the source-class universes with the
  SAME `E ∪ Psm`, `Prd`.

## EXTERNAL PROVIDER

* `SameWeightActualMeasureProvider` — the actual-measure / tensor decomposition for the SAME
  weight: `Pair/N ≤ M_new(Λ) + |DE(Λ)| + C_t √(E|A-B|²) + 90 + err`, with the very same `Λ` in
  the principal functional `M_new` and in the distribution error `DE` (this plays the role of
  the frozen V20 `PairDecompositionProvider` for the new weight; never constructed).

## LEAN CONDITIONAL

* `ellRd_congr` (LEAN BANK) — `ℓ_rd` only sees the endpoints on its own universe;
* `lamFam_source_decomposition` (LEAN BANK) — every `LamFam S τ M` satisfies the V16
  coefficient contract with mass `(R+1)^{#cells} 3^R`, independent of `M`;
* **`repaired_routeC_baseline_of_providers`** — the bundle `RepairedCompletedSieveProvider` +
  `SameWeightActualMeasureProvider` + geometry ⟹ the frozen V16
  `RouteCBaselineProvider τ W N W_F err`, i.e. `‖B_x‖² ≤ A_C W_F + 90 + err + o(1)` for the
  frozen pair functional.  The proof uses the SAME `LamFam S τ M` for the V23 signed-principal
  budget and for the V16 source-class error.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV24
namespace RepairedRouteCBaseline

open Finset
open ResearchBankV22.RoundedRoughSieve ResearchBankV22.CompletedPositiveWeight
open ResearchBankV22.RosserCostProvider ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler ResearchBankV23.HatApproximationProvider
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalBudget
open ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer
open ResearchBankV16.ConditionalRouteCImplication
open RepairedProvider

/-- `ℓ_rd` only depends on the endpoints of its own universe (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem ellRd_congr {γ : Type*} [LinearOrder γ] {U : Finset γ} {w w' : γ → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ p ∈ U, w p = w' p) (X : ℝ) : ellRd U w X = ellRd U w' X := by
  funext A
  unfold ellRd ellW
  split_ifs with hA h1 h2 h2 <;> try rfl
  all_goals exfalso
  · apply h2; intro p hp he
    have := h1 p hp he
    unfold roundedCond at this ⊢
    have hab : above A p ⊆ U := (filter_subset _ _).trans hA
    rwa [prod_congr rfl fun q hq => (hw q (hab hq)).symm, ← hw p (hA hp)]
  · apply h1; intro p hp he
    have := h2 p hp he
    unfold roundedCond at this ⊢
    have hab : above A p ⊆ U := (filter_subset _ _).trans hA
    rwa [prod_congr rfl fun q hq => hw q (hab hq), hw p (hA hp)]

/-- The ACTUAL completed weight of the family at index `(S, τ)` and scale `M`. -/
noncomputable def LamFam (E : Finset ℕ) (Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ) (lev X : ℝ → ℝ)
    (wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) (S : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (M : ℕ) : Finset ℕ → ℝ :=
  LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M)

/-- The rounding cells of the family. -/
structure RoundedCellData (Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ) (wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) (X : ℝ → ℝ) where
  nC : ℕ → ℝ → ℕ
  cell : ∀ S τ, ℕ → ℕ → Fin (nC S τ)
  mono : ∀ S τ (M : ℕ), Monotone (cell S τ M)
  wc : ∀ S τ, ℕ → Fin (nC S τ) → ℝ
  endpoint : ∀ S τ (M : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ Prd S M, wτ τ M p = wc S τ M (cell S τ M p)
  alloc : ∀ S τ, (Fin (nC S τ) → ℕ) → Fin 3 → Fin (nC S τ) → ℕ
  alloc_sum : ∀ S τ κ j, ∑ i, alloc S τ κ i j = κ j
  R : ℕ → ℝ → ℕ
  atoms : ∀ S τ (M : ℕ) A, A ⊆ Prd S M → ellRd (Prd S M) (wτ τ M) (X M) A ≠ 0 → A.card ≤ R S τ

/-- The sieve geometry: disjoint universes, `h < 1` on sieve primes, and the SAME universes in
the principal model and in the source class. -/
structure SieveGeometry (E : Finset ℕ) (Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h) (Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ) : Prop where
  hU : ∀ S M, (model S M).U = E ∪ Psm S M ∪ Prd S M
  hUs : ∀ S M, Us S M = E ∪ Psm S M
  hUr : ∀ S M, Ur S M = Prd S M
  d1 : ∀ S x, Disjoint E (Psm S x)
  d2 : ∀ S x, Disjoint E (Prd S x)
  d3 : ∀ S x, Disjoint (Psm S x) (Prd S x)
  hh : ∀ S x, ∀ p ∈ E ∪ Psm S x ∪ Prd S x, h p < 1

/-- **Every completed weight of the family satisfies the V16 coefficient contract** with an
`M`-independent mass (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem lamFam_source_decomposition {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ}
    {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X) (d1 : ∀ S x, Disjoint E (Psm S x))
    (d2 : ∀ S x, Disjoint E (Prd S x)) (d3 : ∀ S x, Disjoint (Psm S x) (Prd S x))
    (S : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (M : ℕ) :
    SourceDecomposition (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M) (E ∪ Psm S M) (Prd S M)
      (((cd.R S τ + 1) ^ cd.nC S τ : ℕ) * 3 ^ cd.R S τ) := by
  have hcong := ellRd_congr (cd.endpoint S τ M) (X M)
  have hL : LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M =
      LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (fun p => cd.wc S τ M (cd.cell S τ M p)) (X M) := by
    unfold LamFam LambdaNewPlus completedWeight
    rw [hcong]
  rw [hL]
  have := rounded_completed_weight_matches_V16_contract (d1 S M) (d2 S M) (d3 S M)
    (cd.cell S τ M) (cd.mono S τ M) (cd.wc S τ M) (cd.alloc S τ) (cd.alloc_sum S τ)
    (level := lev M) (R := cd.R S τ) (fun A hA hne => cd.atoms S τ M A hA (by rw [hcong]; exact hne))
  simpa [Fintype.card_fin] using this

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- **Same-weight actual-measure / tensor decomposition** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; never
constructed): the frozen pair functional is bounded by the principal functional and the
distribution error of the SAME weight `Λ S τ M`, the tensor approximation error, and the fixed
off-principal part `90 + err`. -/
structure SameWeightActualMeasureProvider (τC : FixedTupleC V) (W : WeightSystem τC) (N : ℕ → ℝ)
    {h : ℕ → ℝ} (model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h) (pref : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Λ : ℕ → ℝ → ℕ → Finset ℕ → ℝ) (DE : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) (EAB : ℕ → ℝ) (Ct err : ℝ) :
    Prop where
  Ct_nonneg : 0 ≤ Ct
  decomp : ∀ S τ M, Pair τC W M / N M ≤
    (model S M).Mnew (pref M) (Λ S τ M) + |DE M (Λ S τ M)| + Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| + 90 + err

/-- **The repaired Route-C baseline** (LEAN CONDITIONAL on the explicit providers).  The SAME
completed weight `LamFam S τ M` is used in the principal term (V23 budget) and in the error term
(V16 source class). -/
theorem repaired_routeC_baseline_of_providers {K : ℕ} {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ}
    {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ} {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ} {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ}
    {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ} {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ}
    {DE : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct err : ℝ} (τC : FixedTupleC V) (W : WeightSystem τC)
    (P : RepairedCompletedSieveProvider K h F Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I (S0 τC W) N Li phiW model
      Kh EAB Us Ur DE)
    (D : SameWeightActualMeasureProvider τC W N model (pref Li phiW N)
      (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ) DE EAB Ct err)
    (G : SieveGeometry E Psm Prd h model Us Ur) (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X)
    (hLi : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) (hphi : 0 < phiW) (hWF : 0 ≤ LF / I) :
    RouteCBaselineProvider τC W N (LF / I) err := by
  refine ⟨fun η hη => ?_⟩
  -- principal side: V23 budget for the SAME weight
  obtain ⟨S, -, τ, -, M1, hM1⟩ := principal_budget_le_A_C P.rosser P.tuple P.euler G.hU G.d1 G.d2
    G.d3 G.hh hLi hphi hWF (η / 3) (by positivity)
  -- error side: V16 source class for the SAME weight
  set Cm : ℝ := (((cd.R S τ + 1) ^ cd.nC S τ : ℕ) : ℝ) * 3 ^ cd.R S τ
  have hCm : 0 ≤ Cm := by positivity
  have hdec : ∀ M, SourceDecomposition (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M) (Us S M) (Ur S M) Cm := by
    intro M
    rw [G.hUs, G.hUr]
    exact lamFam_source_decomposition cd G.d1 G.d2 G.d3 S τ M
  obtain ⟨M2, hM2⟩ := distribution_error_small P.source S (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ) hCm hdec
    (η / 3) (by positivity)
  -- tensor side
  have hCt := D.Ct_nonneg
  set δ : ℝ := η / (3 * (Ct + 1))
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by positivity
  obtain ⟨M3, hM3⟩ := hat_approximation_eventually_small P.hat (δ ^ 2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨max M1 (max M2 M3), fun M hM => ?_⟩
  have hM1' : M1 ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hM
  have hM2' : M2 ≤ M := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hM
  have hM3' : M3 ≤ M := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hM
  have e1 := hM1 M hM1'
  have e2 := hM2 M hM2'
  have e3 : Real.sqrt |EAB M| ≤ δ := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left hδ.le]
    exact hM3 M hM3'
  have e3' : Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| ≤ η / 3 := by
    calc Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| ≤ Ct * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 hCt
      _ ≤ (Ct + 1) * δ := by nlinarith
      _ = η / 3 := by simp only [δ]; field_simp
  have hdec' := D.decomp S τ M
  have hmain : (model S M).Mnew (pref Li phiW N M) (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M) ≤
      ((A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) * (LF / I) + η / 3 := e1
  linarith

end RepairedRouteCBaseline
end ResearchBankV24
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.Ledger

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V24: final status ledger (append-only)

namespace Erdos287

/-- The complete V24 ledger. -/
def v24Ledger : List RowV16 := ResearchBankV23.Ledger.v23Ledger ++ v24New

theorem v24_preserves_v23_ledger :
    v24Ledger.take ResearchBankV23.Ledger.v23Ledger.length = ResearchBankV23.Ledger.v23Ledger ∧
      ∀ r ∈ ResearchBankV23.Ledger.v23Ledger, r ∈ v24Ledger :=
  ⟨List.take_left, fun _ hr => List.mem_append_left _ hr⟩

def clsOf (n : String) : Option SemClass := ((v24New.find? fun r => r.nm = n).bind RowV16.cls?)

/-- **The required final status** (section 22 of the programme). -/
theorem v24_final_status :
    clsOf "V16-V20" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "normalized sieve monotonicity" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "spectator-conditioned quadratic domination" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "V17 density-invariance shortcut" = some .repairedRetired ∧
    clsOf "rounded rough-sieve finite positivity" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "completed positive weight" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "exact cell-colouring identity" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "independent coefficient factorization" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "packing/range margins" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "Rosser scalar asymptotic" = some .externalProvider ∧
    clsOf "principal CRT probability" = some .leanBank ∧

    clsOf "explicit M0" = some .open ∧
    clsOf "finite splice" = some .open ∧
    clsOf "global Erdős #287" = some .open := by
  decide

/-- The global problem stays `OPEN` in every V21–V24 ledger. -/
theorem v24_global_open :
    clsOf "global Erdős #287" = some .open ∧
      ResearchBankV23.Ledger.clsOf "Erdős #287" = some .open ∧
      ResearchBankV22.Ledger.clsOf "Erdős #287" = some .open ∧
      ResearchBankV21.Ledger.clsOf "Erdős #287" = some .open := by
  decide

/-- No V24 row claims the global theorem as proved. -/
theorem v24_no_global_claim :
    ∀ r ∈ v24New, r.nm = "global Erdős #287" → r.cls? = some .open := by
  decide

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V30 §19: the final pre-effectivity theorem

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**
**Explicit `M₀` is OPEN.  Finite splice is OPEN.**

`pre_effectivity_287_FINAL_BANK` (LEAN CONDITIONAL):

    MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders  (EXTERNAL analytic inputs only)
    → FunctionalKernelCertificate     (FINITE CERTIFIED INPUT)
    → InternalGlueOwner               (INTERNAL composition obligation — NOT eliminated)
    → structural sieve geometry / rounded cell data / Li ≥ 0 / φ(W) > 0
    → ∃ M₀, ∀ M ≥ M₀, NoCounterexampleAt M.

**Classification: this is NOT "SUCCESS A".**  The theorem still depends on the internal glue
owner (actual-measure majorization with physically defined branch functionals + clean
realization of the nonzero branch, including DIClass membership and the pruning contract), and on
the structural hypotheses about the uninterpreted sieve universes.  See `Status` and the V30
report: the outcome is SUCCESS D (same-source chain not established; first mismatch at the
zero-frequency functional `D0`), with the internal residue isolated in ONE named structure.

The chain: `full_pair_composition` → `baseline_of_full_pair` (exact `27/5 = 90 + errFinal`) →
`ResearchBankV20.ConditionalAsymptotic287.conditional_asymptotic_287_of_baseline` with the frozen
thin certificate (from `FunctionalKernelCertificate`), `thin_margin_check_final`, the principal
provider's `S0Contract` and the `S1Contract` — all at the SAME `N`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV30
namespace FinalPreEffectivity

open ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer ResearchBankV13.FiniteRepresentationModel
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler ResearchBankV24.RepairedRouteCBaseline
open ResearchBankV27.DISpectral ResearchBankV28.ExactParameterInstantiation
open ResearchBankV29.ProviderElimination ResearchBankV29.FunctionalCertificate

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- **The pre-effectivity #287 research-bank theorem** (LEAN CONDITIONAL; see classification). -/
theorem pre_effectivity_287_FINAL_BANK {τC : FixedTupleC V} {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ}
    {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ}
    {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
    {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ} {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ}
    {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz : ℝ}
    {muF : ℝ} {DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop}
    (Mn : MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model
      Kh EAB Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db muF DIClass)
    (C : FunctionalKernelCertificate muF (LF / I))
    (Gl : InternalGlueOwner τC W h E Psm Prd lev X wτ N Li phiW model EAB D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz
      ((errFinal : ℚ) : ℝ) DIClass)
    (G : SieveGeometry E Psm Prd h model Us Ur) (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X)
    (hLi : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) (hphi : 0 < phiW) :
    ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, NoCounterexampleAt M :=
  ResearchBankV20.ConditionalAsymptotic287.conditional_asymptotic_287_of_baseline τC W N
    ((certificate_iff_thin muF (LF / I)).1 C) thin_margin_check_final
    Mn.euler.normalization_agreement Mn.s1
    (SameNormalizationChain.baseline_of_full_pair
      (FullPairComposition.full_pair_composition Mn C Gl G cd hLi hphi))

end FinalPreEffectivity
end ResearchBankV30

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V30 §14: full end-to-end pair composition

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

`full_pair_composition` composes, in ONE proof and by explicit declaration references:

1. completed positive upper sieve / source decomposition of the SAME weight
   `Λ = LamFam S τ M = LambdaNewPlus …` — `lamFam_source_decomposition` (V24, LEAN BANK);
2. principal + remainder split — the glue owner's `tensor.decomp` (INTERNAL, not eliminated);
3. zero / one-large / two-large / boundary branches — `derived_source_class_provider` (V28) and
   `distribution_error_small` (V24) from the four EXTERNAL branch class bounds;
4. Type-II / clean nonzero theorem — `nonzero_branch_small` (V28, from the V27 derived
   `clean_nonzero_derived`), with the glue owner's `nonzero` realizations (INTERNAL);
5. same-weight principal bound — `principal_budget_le_A_C` (V23);
6. tensor approximation (`B_x` norm) — `hat_approximation_eventually_small` (V23);
7. actual-measure transfer and the final `P_actual/N_x` bound with the exact constant
   `90 + errFinal = 27/5`.

Conclusion (explicit eventual / error interface): for every `η > 0` there are `S, τ` (chosen
BEFORE `M`) and `M₀` such that for all `M ≥ M₀`: the `B_x` norm of the weight `LamFam S τ M`
satisfies `‖B_x‖² ≤ A_C W_F + η`, and `P_actual(M)/N(M) ≤ A_C W_F + 27/5 + η`.

LEAN CONDITIONAL on `MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders`, the certificate AND the internal glue
owner `InternalGlueOwner` (which V29 could not eliminate).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV30
namespace FullPairComposition

open Finset
open ResearchBankV22.RosserCostProvider
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler ResearchBankV23.HatApproximationProvider
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalBudget
open ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer
open ResearchBankV24.RepairedProvider ResearchBankV24.RepairedRouteCBaseline
open ResearchBankV27.DISpectral
open ResearchBankV28.RepairedAnalyticBundle ResearchBankV28.ExactParameterInstantiation
open ResearchBankV28.FinalPairComposition
open ResearchBankV29.ProviderElimination ResearchBankV29.FunctionalCertificate

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- **Full end-to-end pair composition** (LEAN CONDITIONAL). -/
theorem full_pair_composition {τC : FixedTupleC V} {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ} {h : ℕ → ℝ}
    {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ}
    {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
    {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ} {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ}
    {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz : ℝ}
    {muF : ℝ} {DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop}
    (Mn : MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model
      Kh EAB Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db muF DIClass)
    (C : FunctionalKernelCertificate muF (LF / I))
    (Gl : InternalGlueOwner τC W h E Psm Prd lev X wτ N Li phiW model EAB D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz
      ((errFinal : ℚ) : ℝ) DIClass)
    (G : SieveGeometry E Psm Prd h model Us Ur) (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X)
    (hLi : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) (hphi : 0 < phiW) :
    ∀ η > 0, ∃ S : ℕ, ∃ τ : ℝ, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀,
      BxSq model (pref Li phiW N) (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ) (sumDE D0 D1 D2 Db) DEnz EAB Ct
          S τ M ≤ ((A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) * (LF / I) + η ∧
        Pair τC W M / N M ≤ ((A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) * (LF / I) + 27 / 5 + η := by
  intro η hη
  have hWF : 0 ≤ LF / I := C.WF_nonneg
  -- 5. same-weight principal bound (V23)
  obtain ⟨S, -, τ, -, M1, hM1⟩ := principal_budget_le_A_C Mn.rosser Mn.tuple Mn.euler G.hU G.d1
    G.d2 G.d3 G.hh hLi hphi hWF (η / 4) (by positivity)
  -- 1. completed positive sieve: the SAME weight has a source decomposition (V24)
  set Cm : ℝ := (((cd.R S τ + 1) ^ cd.nC S τ : ℕ) : ℝ) * 3 ^ cd.R S τ
  have hCm : 0 ≤ Cm := by positivity
  have hdec : ∀ M, SourceDecomposition (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M) (Us S M) (Ur S M) Cm := by
    intro M
    rw [G.hUs, G.hUr]
    exact lamFam_source_decomposition cd G.d1 G.d2 G.d3 S τ M
  -- 3. zero / one-large / two-large / boundary branches (EXTERNAL class bounds)
  have Psrc := derived_source_class_provider Mn.zeroFreq Mn.oneLarge Mn.twoLarge Mn.boundary
  obtain ⟨M2, hM2⟩ := distribution_error_small Psrc S (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ) hCm hdec
    (η / 4) (by positivity)
  -- 4. Type-II / clean nonzero theorem (V27 derived, glue-owner realizations)
  obtain ⟨M4, hM4⟩ := nonzero_branch_small Mn.di
    (fun M => DEnz M (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M)) (fun M => Gl.nonzero S τ M)
    (η / 4) (by positivity)
  -- 6. tensor approximation / B_x norm
  have hCt := Gl.tensor.Ct_nonneg
  set δ : ℝ := η / (4 * (Ct + 1))
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by positivity
  obtain ⟨M3, hM3⟩ := hat_approximation_eventually_small Mn.hat (δ ^ 2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨S, τ, max (max M1 M2) (max M3 M4), fun M hM => ?_⟩
  have e1 := hM1 M (by omega)
  have e2 := hM2 M (by omega)
  have e4 := hM4 M (by omega)
  have e3 : Real.sqrt |EAB M| ≤ δ := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left hδ.le]; exact hM3 M (by omega)
  have e3' : Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| ≤ η / 4 := by
    calc Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| ≤ Ct * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 hCt
      _ ≤ (Ct + 1) * δ := by nlinarith
      _ = η / 4 := by simp only [δ]; field_simp
  -- 2./7. principal + remainder split and actual-measure transfer (glue owner)
  have hsplit := Gl.tensor.decomp S τ M
  have herr : ((errFinal : ℚ) : ℝ) = -423 / 5 := by unfold errFinal; push_cast; ring
  have hmain : (model S M).Mnew (pref Li phiW N M) (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M) ≤
      ((A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) * (LF / I) + η / 4 := e1
  simp only at e4
  rw [herr] at hsplit
  unfold BxSq
  constructor <;> linarith

end FullPairComposition
end ResearchBankV30

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV30.SameNormalizationChain

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V30 §18: quantifier order

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The intended order is realized by the SHAPE of the statements (LEAN CONDITIONAL):

1. tuple / kernel / base / tensor data — the theorem PARAMETERS `τC, W, h, E, Psm, Prd, lev, X,
   wτ, model, Kh, EAB, …` and the finite pattern / colouring type `V` are fixed first;
2. `ρ = 1/1000000` — a fixed rational constant (`rho_fixed`), not a function of `x`;
3. the small-sieve parameter `S` and 4. the cell width `τ` — chosen by `∃ S, ∃ τ` AFTER the
   tolerance `η` and BEFORE `M₀` and `M`;
5. finite patterns / colourings / exceptional states — part of the fixed parameters (step 1);
6. branchwise representations — the V24 source decomposition of `LamFam S τ M` has a coefficient
   mass `(R(S,τ)+1)^{nC(S,τ)} 3^{R(S,τ)}` depending only on `(S, τ)` (`mass_independent_of_M`);
7. `x = M → ∞` — the innermost `∀ M ≥ M₀`.

`quantifier_order_respected` is the `B_x` / pair bound in exactly this order; `S, τ` are bound by
an existential OUTSIDE `∀ M` and occur in the conclusion (through the weight `LamFam S τ M` in
`BxSq`), so the weight used at every scale `M` has parameters that cannot depend on `M`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV30
namespace QuantifierOrder

open ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler ResearchBankV24.RepairedProvider
open ResearchBankV24.RepairedRouteCBaseline
open ResearchBankV27.DISpectral ResearchBankV28.ExactParameterInstantiation
open ResearchBankV28.RepairedAnalyticBundle ResearchBankV28.FinalPairComposition
open ResearchBankV29.ProviderElimination ResearchBankV29.FunctionalCertificate

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- `ρ` is a fixed constant (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem rho_fixed : ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters.rho = 1 / 1000000 := rfl

/-- The representation mass depends only on `(S, τ)` (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem mass_independent_of_M {Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {X : ℝ → ℝ}
    {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev : ℝ → ℝ} (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X)
    (d1 : ∀ S x, Disjoint E (Psm S x)) (d2 : ∀ S x, Disjoint E (Prd S x))
    (d3 : ∀ S x, Disjoint (Psm S x) (Prd S x)) (S : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) :
    ∀ M : ℕ, SourceDecomposition (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M) (E ∪ Psm S M) (Prd S M)
      ((((cd.R S τ + 1) ^ cd.nC S τ : ℕ) : ℝ) * 3 ^ cd.R S τ) :=
  fun M => lamFam_source_decomposition cd d1 d2 d3 S τ M

/-- **The quantifier order is respected** (LEAN CONDITIONAL). -/
theorem quantifier_order_respected {τC : FixedTupleC V} {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ}
    {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ}
    {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
    {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ} {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ}
    {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz : ℝ}
    {muF : ℝ} {DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop}
    (Mn : MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model
      Kh EAB Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db muF DIClass)
    (C : FunctionalKernelCertificate muF (LF / I))
    (Gl : InternalGlueOwner τC W h E Psm Prd lev X wτ N Li phiW model EAB D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz
      ((errFinal : ℚ) : ℝ) DIClass)
    (G : SieveGeometry E Psm Prd h model Us Ur) (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X)
    (hLi : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) (hphi : 0 < phiW) :
    ∀ η > 0, ∃ S : ℕ, ∃ τ : ℝ, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀,
      BxSq model (pref Li phiW N) (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ) (sumDE D0 D1 D2 Db) DEnz EAB Ct
          S τ M ≤ ((A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) * (LF / I) + η ∧
        Pair τC W M / N M ≤ ((A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) * (LF / I) + 27 / 5 + η :=
  FullPairComposition.full_pair_composition Mn C Gl G cd hLi hphi

end QuantifierOrder
end ResearchBankV30
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4214 sha256=9c41967a4695cf7854e467c3386fd739fe18e2c2c48c9a1c19d59243ebd080fd path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV30/SameNormalizationChain.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV30.SameWeightChain

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V30 §17: same normalization end to end

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

`same_normalization_end_to_end` (LEAN CONDITIONAL): for ONE `R : RouteCNormalization`,
* S0 scale: `S0Contract (S0 τC W) R.N`;
* S1 scale: `S1Contract (S1 τC W) R.N μ_F`;
* principal scale: `pref Li phiW R.N M = Li M / (phiW · R.N M)`;
* pair baseline: `RouteCBaselineProvider τC W R.N W_F errFinal` (exact conversion
  `A_C W_F + 27/5 + η = A_C W_F + 90 + errFinal + η`, no asymptotic equivalence);
* actual pair: eventually `Pair/R.N ≤ A_C W_F + 27/5 + η`;
* score: the exact consumer check `ThinMarginCheck μ_lo W_hi errFinal`, which is what
  `conditional_asymptotic_287_of_baseline` consumes together with the three contracts at the SAME
  `R.N`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV30
namespace SameNormalizationChain

open ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer
open ResearchBankV16.ConditionalRouteCImplication
open ResearchBankV14.ConditionalAsymptoticImplication (S0Contract S1Contract)
open ResearchBankV17.ThinFunctional
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler ResearchBankV24.RepairedRouteCBaseline
open ResearchBankV27.DISpectral ResearchBankV28.RepairedAnalyticBundle
open ResearchBankV28.ExactParameterInstantiation
open ResearchBankV29.ProviderElimination ResearchBankV29.FunctionalCertificate
open ResearchBankV29.SourceNormalization

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- The pair baseline from the full composition, with the exact constant conversion. -/
theorem baseline_of_full_pair {τC : FixedTupleC V} {W : WeightSystem τC} {N : ℕ → ℝ} {WF : ℝ}
    {Q : ℝ → ℕ → ℝ → ℕ → Prop}
    (h : ∀ η > 0, ∃ S : ℕ, ∃ τ : ℝ, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀,
      Q η S τ M ∧ Pair τC W M / N M ≤ ((A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) * WF + 27 / 5 + η) :
    RouteCBaselineProvider τC W N WF ((errFinal : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
  refine ⟨fun η hη => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨_, _, M₀, hM₀⟩ := h η hη
  refine ⟨M₀, fun M hM => ?_⟩
  have herr : ((errFinal : ℚ) : ℝ) = -423 / 5 := by unfold errFinal; push_cast; ring
  rw [herr]; linarith [(hM₀ M hM).2]

/-- **Same normalization end to end** (LEAN CONDITIONAL). -/
theorem same_normalization_end_to_end (R : RouteCNormalization) {τC : FixedTupleC V}
    {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ} {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ}
    {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ} {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ} {Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ}
    {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ} {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ}
    {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz : ℝ} {muF : ℝ}
    {DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop}
    (Mn : MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I R.N Li phiW model
      Kh EAB Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db muF DIClass)
    (C : FunctionalKernelCertificate muF (LF / I))
    (Gl : InternalGlueOwner τC W h E Psm Prd lev X wτ R.N Li phiW model EAB D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz
      ((errFinal : ℚ) : ℝ) DIClass)
    (G : SieveGeometry E Psm Prd h model Us Ur) (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X)
    (hLi : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) (hphi : 0 < phiW) :
    S0Contract (S0 τC W) R.N ∧
    S1Contract (S1 τC W) R.N muF ∧
    (∀ M, pref Li phiW R.N M = Li M / (phiW * R.N M)) ∧
    RouteCBaselineProvider τC W R.N (LF / I) ((errFinal : ℚ) : ℝ) ∧
    (∀ η > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, Pair τC W M / R.N M ≤ ((A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) * (LF / I) + 27 / 5 + η) ∧
    ThinMarginCheck muLo WHi errFinal := by
  have hfull := FullPairComposition.full_pair_composition Mn C Gl G cd hLi hphi
  refine ⟨Mn.euler.normalization_agreement, Mn.s1, fun _ => rfl, baseline_of_full_pair hfull,
    fun η hη => ?_, thin_margin_check_final⟩
  obtain ⟨_, _, M₀, hM₀⟩ := hfull η hη
  exact ⟨M₀, fun M hM => (hM₀ M hM).2⟩

end SameNormalizationChain
end ResearchBankV30
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4247 sha256=20bc6394d99301c545143dc08057245e0af9800c3c2b7f21eb5cd9e42fa95916 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV30/SameSourceChain.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV30.FullPairComposition

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V30 §15: same-source chain

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## What IS established (LEAN CONDITIONAL, `same_source_end_to_end`)

At the level of the objects that exist in the bank, ONE physical source `(τC, W)` feeds every
consumer: `S0 τC W` (principal normalization), `S1 τC W` (first moment) and `Pair τC W` (the pair
count majorized by the glue owner's actual-measure decomposition) — no model sequence replaces
`Pair τC W` anywhere in the final chain, and all branch functionals are evaluated at the SAME
weight `LamFam S τ M`.

## What is NOT established — SEMANTIC MISMATCH (SUCCESS D)

The task asks to track the source identity through the tensor/cell split, fixed-state split, HB
split, dyadic/fine boxes, colour split and clean-state extraction.  In V2–V28 these splits are
proved as identities about EXPLICIT finite sums (V25 centering, V26 HB/boxes/bins, V27 colour
orbits), but **no declaration applies them to `Pair τC W`**: the branch functionals
`D0, D1, D2, Db, DEnz` are uninterpreted parameters, linked to `Pair` only by the glue owner's
`tensor.decomp` inequality.  `same_source_not_established` proves that the four branch fields,
the DI field and the nonzero realization are all satisfied by the ZERO functionals with the empty
DI class — so nothing in the bank forces the branch functionals to be the physical branch sums.

**First mismatch:** the zero-frequency functional `D0` (first branch in the chain) is not
defined from the physical source `(τC, W)`; the same holds for `D1, D2, Db, DEnz`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV30
namespace SameSourceChain

open ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer
open ResearchBankV14.ConditionalAsymptoticImplication (S0Contract S1Contract)
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler ResearchBankV24.RepairedRouteCBaseline
open ResearchBankV27.DISpectral ResearchBankV28.RepairedAnalyticBundle
open ResearchBankV29.ProviderElimination

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- **Same source end to end** (LEAN CONDITIONAL, at the level of existing objects). -/
theorem same_source_end_to_end {τC : FixedTupleC V} {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ} {h : ℕ → ℝ}
    {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ}
    {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
    {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ} {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ}
    {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz err : ℝ}
    {muF : ℝ} {DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop}
    (Mn : MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model
      Kh EAB Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db muF DIClass)
    (Gl : InternalGlueOwner τC W h E Psm Prd lev X wτ N Li phiW model EAB D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz
      err DIClass) :
    S0Contract (S0 τC W) N ∧ S1Contract (S1 τC W) N muF ∧
      ∀ S τ M, Pair τC W M / N M ≤
        (model S M).Mnew (pref Li phiW N M) (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M) +
          |sumDE D0 D1 D2 Db M (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M)| +
          max (DEnz M (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M)) 0 + Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| + 90 + err :=
  ⟨Mn.euler.normalization_agreement, Mn.s1, Gl.tensor.decomp⟩

/-- **The same-source chain is NOT established by the bank** (LEAN BANK): the zero functionals
with the empty DI class satisfy every branch field, the DI field and the nonzero realization. -/
theorem same_source_not_established (Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ) :
    BranchClassBound Us Ur (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
      DISpectralProvider (1 / 1100) (fun _ => False) ∧
      ∀ M : ℕ, NonzeroCleanRealization (fun _ => False) (M : ℝ) 0 0 :=
  ⟨ResearchBankV29.ZeroBranchComposition.branchClassBound_zero Us Ur,
    ResearchBankV29.DIClassRealization.di_provider_empty_class _,
    fun M => ResearchBankV29.NonzeroPruning.nonzero_realization_zero _ (Nat.cast_nonneg M) le_rfl⟩

end SameSourceChain
end ResearchBankV30
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV30.SameSourceChain

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V30 §16: same auxiliary weight end to end

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

`same_auxiliary_weight_end_to_end` (LEAN CONDITIONAL): for every `η > 0` there are `S, τ, M₀`
such that for `M ≥ M₀`, with the ONE weight
`Λ = LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M)`:
* (physical upper majorant = remainder) the glue owner's actual-measure majorization of `Pair/N`
  holds with `Λ` in the principal slot, the source-branch remainder slot and the nonzero slot;
* (principal evaluation) the same-weight principal bound `M_new(Λ) ≤ A_C W_F + η` holds for the
  SAME `Λ` (same `S, τ, M`);
* `Λ` has a V24 source decomposition (the weight consumed by the branch class bounds).

The statement literally substitutes `LambdaNewPlus` in every slot; it type-checks because
`LamFam … S τ M` is definitionally that weight (`lamFam_eq_lambdaNewPlus`).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV30
namespace SameWeightChain

open ResearchBankV22.CompletedPositiveWeight
open ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler ResearchBankV23.PrincipalBudget
open ResearchBankV24.RepairedProvider ResearchBankV24.RepairedRouteCBaseline
open ResearchBankV27.DISpectral ResearchBankV28.RepairedAnalyticBundle
open ResearchBankV29.ProviderElimination ResearchBankV29.FunctionalCertificate

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- **Same auxiliary weight end to end** (LEAN CONDITIONAL). -/
theorem same_auxiliary_weight_end_to_end {τC : FixedTupleC V} {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ}
    {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ}
    {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
    {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ} {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ}
    {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz err : ℝ}
    {muF : ℝ} {DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop}
    (Mn : MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model
      Kh EAB Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db muF DIClass)
    (C : FunctionalKernelCertificate muF (LF / I))
    (Gl : InternalGlueOwner τC W h E Psm Prd lev X wτ N Li phiW model EAB D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz
      err DIClass)
    (G : SieveGeometry E Psm Prd h model Us Ur) (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X)
    (hLi : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) (hphi : 0 < phiW) :
    ∀ η > 0, ∃ S : ℕ, ∃ τ : ℝ, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀,
      (Pair τC W M / N M ≤
        (model S M).Mnew (pref Li phiW N M)
            (LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M)) +
          |sumDE D0 D1 D2 Db M (LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M))| +
          max (DEnz M (LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M))) 0 +
          Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| + 90 + err) ∧
      (model S M).Mnew (pref Li phiW N M)
          (LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M)) ≤
        ((A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) * (LF / I) + η ∧
      SourceDecomposition (LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M))
        (Us S M) (Ur S M) ((((cd.R S τ + 1) ^ cd.nC S τ : ℕ) : ℝ) * 3 ^ cd.R S τ) := by
  intro η hη
  obtain ⟨S, -, τ, -, M1, hM1⟩ := principal_budget_le_A_C Mn.rosser Mn.tuple Mn.euler G.hU G.d1
    G.d2 G.d3 G.hh hLi hphi C.WF_nonneg η hη
  refine ⟨S, τ, M1, fun M hM => ⟨Gl.tensor.decomp S τ M, hM1 M hM, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [G.hUs, G.hUr]
  exact lamFam_source_decomposition cd G.d1 G.d2 G.d3 S τ M

end SameWeightChain
end ResearchBankV30
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=3148 sha256=6ed9ce90d3852abf16b9879396b6726866776d6e9b63d38c8b98ba6a76f15eb3 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV30/Status.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV30.TrustedChallenge
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV29.Ledger

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V30 §23: success classification

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The four outcomes of task §23, and the one reached (checked by `decide` against the V29 ledger).

* **Not SUCCESS A:** internal rows remain (`ResearchBankV29.Ledger.remaining_internal`).
* **Not SUCCESS B in the strict sense:** the residual internal content is packaged in ONE
  structure (`InternalGlueOwner`) but consists of two derivations (actual-measure majorization
  and nonzero clean realization, the latter containing DIClass membership, kernel realization
  and the pruning contract).
* **SUCCESS C is avoided:** no provider in `MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders` was strengthened;
  the degenerate route (`old_FinalAnalyticProviders_of_degenerate`) that WOULD need a stronger
  tensor provider is recorded but not used.
* **SUCCESS D (reached):** the same-source chain is not established; first mismatch — the
  zero-frequency functional `D0` is not defined from the physical source
  (`SameSourceChain.same_source_not_established`).  The same-weight and same-normalization chains
  DO hold (`same_auxiliary_weight_end_to_end`, `same_normalization_end_to_end`).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV30
namespace Status

open ResearchBankV25.Ledger

/-- The §23 outcomes. -/
inductive Outcome
  | successA_finalBank
  | successB_oneInternalGlue
  | successC_providerMismatch
  | successD_semanticMismatch
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The semantic chains of §15–§17. -/
inductive Chain
  | sameSource
  | sameWeight
  | sameNormalization
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

open Chain

/-- Which chains are established in Lean. -/
def established : Chain → Bool
  | sameSource => false
  | sameWeight => true
  | sameNormalization => true

/-- The outcome reached. -/
def reached : Outcome := Outcome.successD_semanticMismatch

/-- The first failing chain. -/
def firstMismatch : Chain := sameSource

/-- The global-status rows (unchanged from V28). -/
inductive GlobalItem
  | explicitM0
  | finiteSplice
  | globalErdos287
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def globalStatus : GlobalItem → StatusClass
  | .explicitM0 => .openProblem
  | .finiteSplice => .openProblem
  | .globalErdos287 => .openProblem

/-- **Final classification** (checked). -/
theorem final_classification :
    reached = Outcome.successD_semanticMismatch ∧ firstMismatch = sameSource ∧
      established sameSource = false ∧ established sameWeight = true ∧
      established sameNormalization = true ∧
      globalStatus .explicitM0 = .openProblem ∧ globalStatus .finiteSplice = .openProblem ∧
      globalStatus .globalErdos287 = .openProblem := by
  decide

/-- **Not SUCCESS A** (checked against the V29 ledger): an internal row is not eliminated. -/
theorem not_successA :
    ResearchBankV29.Ledger.kind .nonzero = .internal ∧
      ResearchBankV29.Ledger.outcome .nonzero ≠ .eliminated := by
  decide

end Status
end ResearchBankV30
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV30.FinalPreEffectivity

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V30 §21: trusted challenge statement

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Plain statement file.  It contains only:
* the source definitions needed to read the statement, by reference:
  `Erdos287Counterexample` (ProblemStatement: finite set, ≥ 2 elements, all `> 1`, reciprocal sum
  `1`, gaps `≤ 2`), `NoCounterexampleAt` (V13), `MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders`,
  `FunctionalKernelCertificate`, `InternalGlueOwner` (V29);
* `TrustedStatement` — the closed proposition of `pre_effectivity_287_FINAL_BANK`;
* `trusted_challenge : TrustedStatement`, proved by the V30 theorem (no tactics beyond term
  application).
* `noCounterexampleAt_unfold` — `NoCounterexampleAt` literally unfolds to the #287 statement.

Comparator was not available in this environment (`comparator` is not on `PATH`, and
`lake comparator` is not a Lake command), so it was NOT run.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV30
namespace TrustedChallenge

open ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer ResearchBankV13.FiniteRepresentationModel
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler ResearchBankV24.RepairedRouteCBaseline
open ResearchBankV27.DISpectral ResearchBankV28.ExactParameterInstantiation
open ResearchBankV29.ProviderElimination ResearchBankV29.FunctionalCertificate

/-- `NoCounterexampleAt M` unfolds to the literal #287 statement at endpoint `M`. -/
theorem noCounterexampleAt_unfold (M : ℕ) :
    NoCounterexampleAt M ↔ ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ∀ h : Erdos287Counterexample A, A.max' h.nonempty ≠ M :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- **The trusted statement.** -/
def TrustedStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {τC : FixedTupleC V} {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ}
    {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ}
    {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
    {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ} {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ}
    {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz : ℝ}
    {muF : ℝ} {DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop},
    MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model
      Kh EAB Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db muF DIClass →
    FunctionalKernelCertificate muF (LF / I) →
    InternalGlueOwner τC W h E Psm Prd lev X wτ N Li phiW model EAB D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz
      ((errFinal : ℚ) : ℝ) DIClass →
    SieveGeometry E Psm Prd h model Us Ur → RoundedCellData Prd wτ X →
    (∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) → 0 < phiW →
    ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, NoCounterexampleAt M

/-- **Trusted challenge, discharged.** -/
theorem trusted_challenge : TrustedStatement :=
  fun Mn C Gl G cd hLi hphi =>
    FinalPreEffectivity.pre_effectivity_287_FINAL_BANK Mn C Gl G cd hLi hphi

end TrustedChallenge
end ResearchBankV30
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV5.Routes

/-!
# Research Bank V5 — the external asymptotic-input ledger

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

This file makes the load-bearing *external* mathematics visible.  Every entry is an analytic
statement that the contact-core programme consumes but that is **not** formalized in this project.
No entry is inhabited anywhere in the bank; the corresponding Lean `Prop`s live in
`ContactCore/ExternalInterfaces.lean` and appear only as hypotheses.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV5

open EvidenceKind ResearchStatus

/-- Metadata of an external analytic input. -/
structure ExternalInput where
  /-- Short name. -/
  name : String
  /-- The exact mathematical statement, in words. -/
  statement : String
  /-- Source / reference metadata, if available. -/
  source : String
  /-- Where the input is consumed inside the programme. -/
  consumedAt : String
  /-- Research status. -/
  status : ResearchStatus
  /-- Evidence kind; never `kernelProof` for an external input. -/
  evidence : EvidenceKind
  /-- Whether the statement has been independently refereed. -/
  refereed : Bool
  /-- Whether the statement is formalized in this project. -/
  formalized : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- **The external asymptotic-input ledger.** -/
def externalAsymptoticInputs : List ExternalInput :=
  [ { name := "Croot general-modulus reciprocal coverage"
      statement :=
        "For every sufficiently large modulus n, a sufficiently large supply of distinct small " ++
        "primes not dividing n has reciprocal subset sums hitting every residue modulo n."
      source := "Croot-type reciprocal covering result; no formal proof supplied here"
      consumedAt := "ContactCore.CrootGeneralModulus; VAL-TRANS one-demand interface"
      status := bank
      evidence := externalAnalyticBank
      refereed := false
      formalized := false },
    { name := "Croot prime-power corollary"
      statement :=
        "The same coverage statement for prime-power moduli ℓ^k."
      source := "corollary of the general-modulus statement"
      consumedAt := "ContactCore.CrootPrimePowerModulus; valuation-layer one-demand"
      status := bank
      evidence := externalAnalyticBank
      refereed := false
      formalized := false },
    { name := "Croot/PNT multiscale incidence"
      statement :=
        "Multiscale incidence estimate between reciprocal subset sums of primes in dyadic " ++
        "ranges and residue classes, using the prime number theorem."
      source := "multiscale incidence argument; no formal proof supplied here"
      consumedAt := "proof of FP-INTERFACE-GEN"
      status := bank
      evidence := externalAnalyticBank
      refereed := false
      formalized := false },
    { name := "FP-INTERFACE-GEN"
      statement :=
        "If the projection of a Croot-long first-power row language to a Boolean interface T " ++
        "is not the full cube, then |T| ≫_δ N log log p / log N."
      source := "multiscale Croot/PNT incidence argument"
      consumedAt := "ContactCore.FPInterfaceGen"
      status := bank
      evidence := externalAnalyticBank
      refereed := false
      formalized := false },
    { name := "FP-INTERFACE"
      statement :=
        "In the range N ≤ (log p)^B: a non-full-cube projection forces |T| ≥ κ_{δ,B} N."
      source := "specialization of FP-INTERFACE-GEN to the intended range"
      consumedAt := "ContactCore.FPInterface; hypothesis of LINEAR-CHARGE"
      status := bank
      evidence := externalAnalyticBank
      refereed := false
      formalized := false },
    { name := "positive-density multiscale burden"
      statement :=
        "At positive density of scales, the surviving long first-power owners carry a burden " ++
        "of interface coordinates proportional to their heights."
      source := "programme-level asymptotic input"
      consumedAt := "Gate C reduced excess-core analysis"
      status := ResearchStatus.«open»
      evidence := researchConjecture
      refereed := false
      formalized := false } ]

/-- **No external input is formalized in this project.** -/
theorem externalInputs_not_formalized :
    ∀ e ∈ externalAsymptoticInputs, e.formalized = false := by decide

/-- **No external input is recorded as a kernel proof.** -/
theorem externalInputs_not_kernelProof :
    ∀ e ∈ externalAsymptoticInputs, e.evidence ≠ kernelProof := by decide

/-- **No external input is recorded as independently refereed** in this project's metadata. -/
theorem externalInputs_not_refereed :
    ∀ e ∈ externalAsymptoticInputs, e.refereed = false := by decide

end ResearchBankV5
end Erdos287
